name: Sutina
description: A Tajuru Speaker who appointed Nissa a Captain Leaftalker and was killed by the Eldrazi brood.

description_citations.text: "Nissa Revane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sutina dies in the tentacles of Kozilek.
timeline.quote: Before the creature died in the tentacles of Kozilek

citation.text: "Elf", section "Tajuru Nation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kazandu Splinter breaks off from the Tajuru, refusing to see Sutina as their leader.
timeline.quote: they broke off from the nation, refusing to see Speaker Sutina as their leader

citation.text: "Elf", section "The Kazandu Splinter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi brood attacks the Tajuru meeting and kills Sutina.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi brood attacked the meeting and killed Sutina shortly after it began

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi attack Turntimber, killing Speaker Sutina and Hiba and destroying the village Mosscrack.
timeline.quote: However, Eldrazi attack, killing Speaker Sutina and Nissa's friend Hiba , and destroying Mosscrack, a village in the Tajuru home tree.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin kills a goblin to satisfy the Moon Kraken Brinelin; Nissa persuades Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death and the return of the brood, and he guides them through the reefs.
timeline.quote: Saddened by the loss and alarmed by the Eldrazi’s reappearance, Brinelin relents and guides them safely through the reefs.
